name: Elmwood University
source:
After waking up wearing nothing but your underwear at a girls only house party, your university life kicks off to a wild start.

Play as an attractive young male psychology student at a prestigious British university famous for its academic research and equally infamous for its debauchery and sinful culture. Seduce and fall in love with 18 main romanceable characters each with their own unique personalities, kinks & traits and you'll have to employ different strategies for each of them.

Seduce your flatmates, coursemates, cheerleaders and even your professors as you navigate university life and make a name for yourself with meaningful choices that affect your reputation and can impact the entire culture of Elmwood.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/wickedware/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在女孩专用的家庭聚会上只穿内衣醒来后，你的大学生活就开始了疯狂的开始。

扮演一名有吸引力的年轻男性心理学学生，就读于一所英国著名大学，该大学以其学术研究而闻名，也因其放荡和罪恶文化而臭名昭著。引诱并爱上18个浪漫的主要角色，每个角色都有自己独特的个性、怪癖和特质，你必须对每个角色采取不同的策略。

在你度过大学生活时，吸引你的室友、同学、拉拉队队员，甚至你的教授，并通过有意义的选择为自己赢得声誉，这些选择会影响你的声誉并影响整个埃尔姆伍德的文化。
